artworks.title: Zaandam
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian wove paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 13 × 22 cm (5 1/8 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketched from a slightly elevated viewpoint, featuring water, windmills on the horizon,and a sky with clouds. The sketch is created using loose, quick strokes, with a monochromatic color palette dominated by tan and dark ink lines. In the foreground, there are small boats, vegetation, and the water leading to the distant windmills and buildings on the horizon under a textured cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Quai de Montebello
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 15.1 × 22.7 cm (5 15/16 × 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a depiction of a street market scene. The image shows a busy street market with multiple stalls showcasing different goods. The style is characterized by sketchy lines, creating a sense of movement. The buildings in the background are hinted at rather than fully illustrated, highlighting the lively atmosphere of the market. The artwork conveys a dynamic and vibrant urban environment with a spontaneous and light touch.

artworks.title: Passages de l'Opera
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12.7 × 21.5 cm (5 × 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a street view looking down on the entrance of a building labeled "PASSAGES DE L’OPERA." The scene shows detailed architecture, including archways and pillars, with trees framing the structure. A bustling area is depicted below, with light and sketch-like brushstrokes hinting at people and street activity. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia and black tones giving the artwork an aged feel. In the background, more architectural details, like balconies and vertical lines, suggest a historical city ambiance.

artworks.title: Rue de la Rochefoucault
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 13.1 × 22 cm (5 3/16 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in front of a set of storefronts. The image depicts a lively array of shop fronts along a street, with detailing capturing the rustic architecture and the bustling nature of shop business activities. The drawing appears to have been created with a light hand, using pen and ink. The scene features awnings above window displays, with signs written in French visible above the entrances. The shading is achieved through dense hatching, providing depth to the facade and adding a sense of shadow around the displays. The realism is understated, with an emphasis on the atmosphere and vibrancy of life on this street rather than precise detail.

artworks.title: Le Boulevard Poissoniere
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a park setting with trees and a grand building with arches. The scene includes trees in the foreground, with wooden benches and figures in the middle ground. In the background, there is a large building with arches and columns. The use of line and shading creates a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: San Biagio
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene near a waterway with a grand arched structure in the background. Boats are seen along the shore by the water's edge. The archway is centrally positioned, leading the eye into a narrow street lined with buildings. The brushstrokes are delicate, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette consists of muted sepia and gray tones, giving an antiquated feel to the scene. Faint outlines of figures near the arch add life to the architectural focus, with delicate details suggesting window frames and masonry work.

artworks.title: Doorway and Vine
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 23.5 x 16.83 cm (9 1/4 x 6 5/8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 23.81 x 16.83 cm (9 3/8 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an open archway leading into a space beyond, potentially a room or a courtyard. The view is from the exterior looking directly through the archway into the structure. The horizon is not visible within the scene. The etching technique creates detailed depictions of the archway and surrounding textures using fine, delicate lines. The style is linear with hatching strokes to indicate shadows, especially under the arch. The color scheme includes various sepia tones, giving the image a warm and vintage aesthetic. Climbing plants with fine leaves are suggested to be present on the left side and above the archway. In the distance, there are two figures in front of a lighted area, silhouetted against a smaller, bright square opening that could be another room or courtyard in the far background. To the right, there are markings representing a window with some scattered elements that may suggest sparse vegetation or grass.

artworks.title: Fruit-Stall
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.23 x 14.61 cm (8 3/4 x 5 3/4 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 23.18 x 14.61 cm (9 1/8 x 5 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a group of people by the water. There are four individuals in the scene; a woman standing on the left holding a child, two seated figures on her right, and another woman engaging with the group. They are under a canopy casting a soft shadow, with a brick wall and windows in the background. A small rowboat is sketched in the foreground.

artworks.title: Robert Barr
artworks.medium: etching on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etched portrait of a man from the chest upwards. He is presented in a slightly turned profile, facing the right side. The man has a large, full beard and mustache, with minimal detail on his eyes and nose. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and a jacket or coat. The background is a plain, textured surface, likely representing the texture of the etching plate.

artworks.title: Fitzroy Square
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an urban setting with a street curving to the left. There are figures in the street and a detailed building on the right with trees. The perspective diminishes the view of buildings in the distance. The etching style features delicate lines and crosshatching for texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic with light and dark tones for depth.

artworks.title: C. L. Drouet, Sculptor
artworks.medium: drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows a man with his arms crossed, looking to the side with a relaxed stance. He has sharp facial features, including a prominent nose and intense eyes. The man has a thick beard and voluminous hair with a plain background behind him.

artworks.title: C. L. Drouet, Sculptor
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man from the waist up. He is in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right with his arms crossed over his chest. The man has a prominent nose, high cheekbones, an intense gaze, a full beard, and mustache. His hair is voluminous and slightly tousled. He wears a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain with light sketch marks.

artworks.title: Study
artworks.medium: lithotint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated in a three-quarter view, from the base of the neck down to the feet. The person's body is turned slightly to the side, and their head is angled downward. The facial features are not detailed, and the hair looks dark and curly. The person is wearing a long, flowing garment with distinct fabric folds. There are no visible objects or jewelry in their hands. The background shows abstract or impressionistic colors, with varying shades of grey and beige.

artworks.title: Limehouse
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from the water looking toward buildings and ships along the riverbank. The horizon is slightly above the center, where the structures and ships meet the sky. The horizon features tall ships with masts and rigging in faded detail. The water has gentle, sweeping lines, creating a sense of movement. The palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black, adding a dramatic atmosphere. Closest to the viewer, a small rowboat with two figures is present. In the distance, buildings and ships are depicted in a blurred and impressionistic style, emphasizing depth and vastness.

artworks.title: Nocturne
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterscape with a distant view of a city or industrial area. The horizon line is low in the composition, with outlines of buildings and possibly smokestacks on the skyline. The buildings are blurred and misty, with subtle and smooth brushstrokes creating a dreamlike quality. The color palette is soft grayscale, adding to the tranquil feel. Closest to us, a dark figure is visible on the water surface.

artworks.title: Nocturne
artworks.medium: lithotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line, featuring dark, vague shapes of buildings or structures in the distance against a misty backdrop. Above the horizon are chimneys and a dome-like architectural feature, suggesting an industrial or urban environment. The soft brushstrokes create a dreamy atmosphere, with blurred edges. The color palette is muted, primarily gray, enhancing a tranquil and somber mood. Near the forefront, there is a solitary figure on a small boat or craft, barely visible.

artworks.title: The Toilet
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing in profile while looking at something in their hands. The person is wearing a long dress and has neatly arranged hair. The background is a simple dark and soft gray shading.

artworks.title: The Toilet
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a full-body side profile view. She is facing away from the viewer, holding an open fan with her arms bent at the elbows. Her hair is styled up, showing her neck, and she is wearing a long dress that appears elaborate with layers or ruffles. The background is textured and shaded without any clear objects or settings.

artworks.title: Early Morning
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene from an elevated perspective, with a wide expanse of water in view. The horizon is high in the composition, with faint outlines of buildings and structures interrupting the skyline. The brushstrokes are delicate and loose, creating a sense of softness and blending the elements in the scene. The color palette is limited to sepia and soft gray tones. Two figures are barely discernible near the viewer, adding a sense of scale and human presence to the waterscape.

artworks.title: The Broad Bridge
artworks.medium: lithotint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a small rowboat with a single figure, surrounded by a large wooden bridge structure. In the distance, a silhouette of a bridge and urban landscape is visible. The artwork is sketch-like, with pencil strokes creating texture and depth, while shading adds contrast. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily brown and beige.

artworks.title: The Tall Bridge
artworks.medium: lithotint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an arched bridge structure viewed from below. The horizon is low and hidden by the bridge pilings that frame the scene. Additional structures and masts are faintly visible beyond the bridge. The brushstrokes are sketch-like and in a brown sepia tone, creating a rustic effect. The image consists of varying shades of sepia, emphasizing the water's reflective surface.

artworks.title: Gaiety Stage Door
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene with people and a horse-drawn carriage. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing the activity of the scene. The focus is on a group near the entrance of a building slightly towards the left. The brushstrokes are sparse and delicate, with sketch-like qualities. The color palette consists of black and white. Figures are positioned near the building's entrance, with a seated figure on the left. In the background, a horse and carriage are visible, suggesting motion.

artworks.title: Victoria Club
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an urban scene with a street view of a classical architectural facade. The horizon is suggested by the line where the building meets the ground. The architecture features arched windows and decorative elements. The drawing depicts figures and architectural details with loose, sketchy lines to convey movement and activity. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of charcoal or graphite against a light background. People are shown walking or standing, sketched in a way that suggests motion, adding to the lively urban atmosphere.

artworks.title: Old Battersea Bridge
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from below a bridge, looking up at it. The horizon is blocked by the bridge's structure, with faint outlines of buildings or structures in the distance. The sketch features precise line work, resembling architectural or impressionistic styles. The color scheme is monochrome, using shades of black and beige. Figures on the bridge are depicted engaged in various activities, and urban structures are hinted at beyond the bridge.
